description: Insert a forced "Set Movement Route" (event command 205, plus the 505 continuation rows the editor expects) into an event page’s command list, moving a character as part of that page. characterId: -1 player, 0 this event, N event id. Pass a moveRoute from create_move_route. A structurally invalid route or page refuses the write (nothing is saved) — pass force: true to override.

characterId.description: Target character: -1 player, 0 this event, N event id on the map

dryRun.description: Preview only: return a diff of what would change without writing to disk.

force.description: Write even if validation finds structural problems (wrong parameter count, unterminated command list). Off by default: such a write is refused and nothing is written. Advisory warnings never block regardless.

moveRoute.description: The move route to force (e.g. from create_move_route)

list.description: Move commands; auto-terminated with code 0 if missing

position.description: Insertion index; defaults to the end of the list

name: set_movement_route
